item.title: Amaroq begins drilling at Greenland iron-copper-gold prospect
item.summary: Amaroq has started scout drilling at its Minturn iron-copper-gold prospect in Northwest Greenland, the first time the target has been tested below the surface. The programme follows surface sampling conducted in 2025, which returned iron grades of up to 69.5%.
